items: 【Sleep Lumbar Support Pillow for Back Pain Relief】Experience unparalleled comfort and relief with our ergonomically designed lumbar pillow for bed. Crafted to effectively support the lower back, it's ideal for side, back, and stomach sleepers, ensuring optimal spinal alignment throughout the night.

【Multi-Functional Bed Support Pillow for Back, Legs and Knees】This versatile lower back support pillow isn't just for your back. Use it under your knees, legs, or feet, or as a leg elevation bolster, providing targeted comfort and effective pain relief wherever you need it. Perfect for addressing lower back pain, hip pain, leg pain, and joint pain.

【Premium Quality Memory Foam】 Made with high-density memory foam, our sleep lumbar support pillow delivers long-lasting comfort without flattening over time. Enjoy optimal support and spinal alignment every night for hours of uninterrupted sleep.

【Enhanced Lower Back Pain Pillow for Sleeping】Say goodbye to restless nights with this lumbar pillow's optimum waist support, promoting proper spinal alignment while you sleep. A must-have for anyone seeking relief from lower back pain.

【Breathable Easy Clean Cover】This back support pillow features a breathable, soft cover that ensures ultimate comfort and prevents overheating during sleep. Plus, it's machine washable for effortless cleaning, so you can always enjoy a fresh, clean pillow.
